source: Trying to force occupancy upward can also create a trade-off. Registers are useful because they keep thread-local state on chip. Reducing the allowed register count may admit more blocks, but it can also increase instruction count or spill values to local memory. A lower-occupancy kernel with enough ILP may outperform a higher-occupancy version that spills or does more work.[2]
zh: 试图迫使入住率上升也可能会产生一种权衡。寄存器很有用，因为它们在芯片上保存线程本地状态。减少允许的寄存器计数可能会接纳更多块，但它也会增加指令计数或将值溢出到本地内存。具有足够 ILP 的较低占用率内核可能会优于溢出或执行更多工作的较高占用率版本。 [2]
